title: Nourishing Garlicky Slovakian Provola Tagine
description: A hearty, garlicky Slovakian dish featuring provola cheese, cooked in a traditional clay tagine vessel, perfect for a nourishing dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic and bhuna spice mix
Heat the olive oil in the clay tagine vessel over medium heat
Add the sliced provola cheese to the tagine vessel and cook until lightly browned
Add the garlic and spice mix to the tagine vessel and cook for 1 minute
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer
Cover the tagine vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the sauce is bubbly
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot
